privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice for Job Applicants
privacyNotice.body: The first name, last name, email, phone and (if provided) CV information you share as part of this application are processed for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection law. Your data is retained securely for the legal retention period after the posting closes or the process ends unsuccessfully, and is anonymized or deleted afterwards. You may contact us to exercise your rights to access, correct, delete or object to the processing of your personal data.
